changes: Released 2026-11-25 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).
On-demand channels: the Go engine (odrelay) replaces FFmpeg - one shared source connection per channel, first byte in ~1.1-1.3 s.
On-demand: HLS sources supported, including HLS with a separate audio rendition; per-stream HTTP proxy supported; encrypted HLS / fMP4 stays on FFmpeg; DASH stays on ckts.
On-demand: a reader stuck for 60 s is released (no ghost viewers).
Live channels: opt-in Go engine (ffmpeg-golive) for plain copy-to-HLS channels via /home/xc_vm/config/golive_streams.txt; anything else is handed to FFmpeg automatically.
Panel: 'go' badge for channels run by Go; on-demand channels served by Go show codecs, resolution, FPS, bitrate and CPU/RAM.
Panel settings (segments, prebuffers, wait/scan, fail sleep, analyze + probe extra wait, instant off) drive the Go engine without a restart.
Transcoding, filters and logos still use FFmpeg.
